Longer term thesis / experiment

Understand if it’s annoying, but one of the lessons from it is have high conviction in a position and be committed regardless of market conditions

Do it on a new chain while the majority of the market is down

Establish it with momentum before the real bull market starts

And then eventually the market does the work for you

E.g. establishing it as part of the lore of Robinhood chain itself I believe will be significant 

I also believe in a massive value gap between cats and dogs (get that sounds crazy but it’s true lol)

I understand the average thing for people to do is to abandon a position when it’s down, but I want to show them it’s possible to be successful by being patient and being different
